# Ghost Rovers

> A free web app for kids ages 8 to 12. You sit at a 1969 Mission Control console and check on 6 machines NASA left on the Moon. Pick one, press CALL GHOST, and see who answers. Five stay silent. The Apollo 11 Laser Mirror still answers.

Built by La Shara Cordero (team Clew Labs) for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars."

## What's inside
- 6 machines: Apollo 11 Laser Mirror, Eagle's launch pad (Apollo 11 descent stage), Surveyor 3, the Apollo 12 science station (ALSEP), the Apollo 15 rover, the Apollo 17 rover
- Each has its original mission, a short story, 3 kid questions, a NASA photo, and a link to its NASA record
- A spinning 3D Moon (NASA LRO map), live "time on the Moon" clocks, read-aloud, keyboard play

## Data and facts
- Every fact is checked against NASA's NSSDCA catalog: [Fact check](https://github.com/earlgreyhot1701D/ghost-rovers/blob/main/docs/FACT_CHECK.md)
- Sources and licenses: [DATA_SOURCES.md](https://github.com/earlgreyhot1701D/ghost-rovers/blob/main/DATA_SOURCES.md)
